title: Modernizing a University Website for Long-Term Growth
summary: As one of our longest-standing partnerships, the University of Hertfordshire entrusted Admonk with transforming an outdated website into a modern, scalable digital platform. Beyond redesigning the user experience, we implemented a flexible CMS, optimized website performance, and integrated the university's CRM to streamline lead management and simplify content administration for internal teams.

challenge.title: The University of Hertfordshire required a modern platform that would simplify website management while improving the digital experience for prospective students.
items: The legacy website had become difficult to maintain and update.
Slow loading times were affecting usability and engagement.
Content management relied heavily on technical intervention.
Lead management required seamless integration with the university's CRM.
The platform needed to support continuous growth without increasing administrative complexity.

approach.title: Modernized the Digital Platform
approach.summary: We replaced an outdated website with a faster, easier-to-manage platform for the university team.

approach.title: Simplified Content Management
